facts.fact: Adwave states that Google Ads costs are controllable with a daily budget and that even $10 to $25 a day can capture meaningful local demand for an optometry practice (vendor claim, not third-party data).
facts.quote: even $10 to $25 a day can capture meaningful local demand

facts.fact: Adwave states that meaningful Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ad campaigns for an eye care practice start at a few dollars a day (vendor claim, no exact minimum given).
facts.quote: meaningful campaigns start at a few dollars a day

facts.fact: Vendor's channel comparison table lists Google Ads cost for optometry practices as approximately $10-25 per day.
facts.quote: | Google Ads | Capturing exam & eyewear searches | ~$10-25/day | Both | Medium |

facts.fact: Vendor's channel comparison table lists Facebook / Instagram cost for optometry practices as starting from approximately $5 per day.
facts.quote: | Facebook / Instagram | Showing eyewear, building brand | From ~$5/day | Retail + brand | High |

facts.fact: Vendor's FAQ states that $10 to $25 a day on Google Ads plus a small social budget can drive meaningful appointments and eyewear sales for an optometry practice.
facts.quote: $10 to $25 a day on Google Ads and a small social budget can drive meaningful appointments and eyewear sales.

facts.fact: Vendor's guide says a connected TV ad for an eye care practice can be a genuine 30-second video ad targeted to the local area.
facts.quote: Connected TV lets you run a genuine 30-second video ad, showing your welcoming office, your team, and your eyewear selection

facts.fact: Vendor's comparison table lists local SEO / Google Business Profile as free, with cost measured in time rather than money.
facts.quote: | Local SEO / Google Business | Being found in "near me" searches | Free (time) | Both | Medium |

facts.fact: Vendor's comparison table lists Yelp and insurance directory listings as ranging from free to paid.
facts.quote: | Yelp / insurance directories | Reaching insured, comparing patients | Free to paid | Medical | Low |

facts.fact: Adwave's pricing page says practices can get started with its service from $30 a day.
facts.quote: or check [pricing](https://adwave.com/pricing) to get started from $30 a day.

facts.fact: Adwave says it can generate a professional 30-second TV ad from a practice's photos and run it on connected TV and beyond.
facts.quote: generate a professional 30-second ad from your photos, then run it on connected TV and beyond

facts.fact: The page states that there are seven advertising channels available to optometry and eye care practices, though it does not require using all of them.
facts.quote: You don't need all seven channels at full blast
